story.iWant: to record expense transactions with category tracking
story.soThat: I can monitor spending and identify cost optimization opportunities

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: 1. Expense Recording UI: Users can access a "Record Expense" dialog (or toggle in existing form). The form includes: Date, Amount (ZMW), Category, Subcategory (optional/free text for now), Payment Method, Payment Status, Vendor/Supplier, Description, and Receipt/Invoice Number.
2. Validation: System prevents negative amounts. Required fields (Amount, Category, Date, Payment Method) must be populated.
3. Data Persistence: Successful save creates an `expense` transaction in `finance_transactions` collection.
4. Expense List: Finance Transactions list supports filtering by 'expense' type, date range, category, and status.
5. Dashboard Summary: Finance dashboard displays expense summary (Total Expenses, Top Categories).
6. Edit/Delete: Users can edit and delete expense transactions (audit logging deferred to system logs, but soft delete or status change supported).
7. Category Management: Admin can add custom categories. (Note: Full management UI is Story 2.3, but basic support for custom categories in dropdown or store is needed).
8. Funding Source Link: Expenses can be linked to a Funding Source (decrementing its balance is handled in backend/store).

constraints.constraint: LAN-first architecture: Must support offline data entry and sync.
RBAC: Only 'Finance Manager' and 'Admin' roles can access.
Data Integrity: Transaction totals must match individual records.

interfaces.interface: funding_sources collection: Update balance on expense creation

tests.standards: Manual testing as per tech-spec-epic-2.md. Unit tests for store logic recommended.

ideas.test: Record expense with all fields and verify persistence.
Verify funding source balance decrements after expense.
Test offline recording and sync (if offline mode implemented).
Verify RBAC: Resident cannot access expense form.
